description: Transaction receipt on Berachain (eth_getTransactionReceipt): success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in BERA, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use bera_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x19db8c305092673a73e777b690469a0962145d4289a2608e8f62881c3a9ac18a. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: bera_receipt
title: Berachain transaction receipt
